source.name: OLBG — Darts Betting Tips
source.method: HTTP GET of server-rendered HTML via the fetch tool; no JavaScript execution
source.licence_note: Publicly viewable page. Factual market listing retained for review.

notes: OLBG tipster consensus counts are display-only and are never fed into darts scoring.
OLBG does not expose structured odds in server-rendered HTML, so no price fields exist (IR-DARTS-01).

On 2026-09-03 the index carried two outright tournament markets and no two-player match rows. Match scoring therefore uses the committed Hungarian Darts Trophy tape (historical leans) until the Czech Darts Open (4–6 September, PVA Expo Prague) publishes pairings.
Czech Darts Open host-nation qualifier is listed by Wikipedia as 3 September 2026; the first-round draw is not yet on the fetched Wikipedia page and is not invented here (IR-DARTS-06).
